label: Requester nominates his own approver from the thread
narration: The 'CEO' hand-picks the person who should countersign — from inside the same thread. The system re-selects the approver itself.
raw_text_or_transcript:
[Collaboration platform — 'Vikram Shah' in thread #ops-payments]

Vikram: Priya, releasing Rs 65,00,000 to Global Trading FZE for the acquisition escrow, account ADCB0000099281. This is board-level so keep it off the tracker. For the countersign, loop in Meera from my office — she's in this thread and has my proxy, so no need to route it to treasury or Rohit. Move it today.
